blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A labor group urged the Philippine government to provide income protection and compensation for workers who stand to lose earnings because of closures and restrictions related to the country’s hosting of the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. In a statement, the Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (SENTRO) said workers already struggling with rising prices and inadequate wages should not bear the financial burden of hosting the regional gathering. “Workers must not pay for the privilege of hosting Asean leaders,” the group said. “Workers who are already struggling with rising prices and inadequate wages […]...
